name: 犬用乳钙强健骨骼款
description: 蓝调清新宠物补钙套系：奶源卖点、症状痛点、配方轮盘与参数信任收口

styleLock.backgroundSystem: two-tone vertical split of cloud-blue #A9D9EB and lake-blue #7FC3DB for the hero screen; clean white #FFFFFF and soft grey-white #FAFAFA panels for infographic, spec and trust screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft even studio lighting, minimal shadow, soft contact shadows under the product, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: round marble pedestal in #F2F0EC with soft grey veining for the hero; flat clean board surfaces elsewhere
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headline lettering, charcoal #2D2D2D on light panels and #FFFFFF on blue panels
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-outline circle badges, flat rounded pill labels and small yellow underline bars in warm yellow #F6C453 only
styleLock.presentationRules: product upright, stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent scale across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh clean pet-health ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cloud-blue #A9D9EB, lake-blue #7FC3DB, clean white #FFFFFF, charcoal text #2D2D2D and one warm sunshine-yellow accent #F6C453; bright soft even studio lighting with minimal shadow and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headline lettering; consistent rounded pill labels, thin-outline circle badges and small yellow underline bars; clean high-end product photography mixed with flat minimal infographic elements; stable upright product at a consistent slight 3/4 hero angle and scale; balanced breathing margins inside every frame with no reserved gaps; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 长图首屏三秒承接点击，一句话讲清核心补钙卖点与适用生命阶段
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level with a slight 3/4 turn, product upright centered, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright soft even studio lighting, soft contact shadow under the product
shots.background: two-tone vertical split of cloud-blue #A9D9EB and lake-blue #7FC3DB
shots.props: white 3D architectural stair and arch props along the left edge; round marble pedestal #F2F0EC under the product
shots.textZone: top center: kicker on a warm yellow #F6C453 highlight bar, two-line headline below, one short audience tag line under the headline
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce detail-page opening hero for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The product stands upright, centered on a round marble pedestal in #F2F0EC, photographed straight-on at eye-level with a slight 3/4 turn, full product visible. Background is a two-tone vertical split of cloud-blue #A9D9EB and lake-blue #7FC3DB, with 3D architectural stair and arch props in #FFFFFF along the left edge. Bright soft even studio lighting, soft contact shadow grounding the product. Product occupies 50-60% of frame, set slightly low in the composition so the top third carries the copy block. Top center text zone: a short kicker on a warm yellow #F6C453 highlight bar 「{callout_1}」, a two-line #FFFFFF headline 「{callout_2}」, and one short audience tag line below, all balanced over the product. 2K commercial quality. Negative: no brand logos, no watermark, no dense body text, no props covering the product, no harsh shadows, no floating product, no cut-off edges.

provenance.notes: 由 9 片 800×1200 切片（相邻 60px 重叠）拼合的详情页长图提炼。主产品判定为犬用补钙营养补充剂：画面为白色补剂瓶配狗狗实拍，文案围绕狗狗缺钙、幼犬成长、孕期、老年期展开。taxonomy 的宠物用品 L2 无保健品/营养类目，按可食性归入最近的『零食』。已剥离：品牌标签与包装字、会员二维码水印、进口奶源等产地声明、成分保证值具体数字；症状卡片图区在源图为空白，升级为症状线稿插画区；瓶身绿色标签带不写入模版，由用户产品自带。产品一律以 {product} 占位。
